kaikki_vikisozluk.e: شُرْشُور • (šuršūr) m (plural شَرَاشِير (šarāšīr))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From the root ش ر ش ر (š r š r) meaning “to scatter”, “to spread”, “to cut into pieces”, especially said of grass and wheat; so called for its habit of eating waste grain among chaff; compare English chaffinch.
s: ش ر ش ر (š r š r)

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: شَرْشَرَ • (šaršara) Iq (non-past يُشَرْشِرُ (yušarširu), verbal noun شَرْشَرَة (šaršara))
g: to scatter, to make leap forth and abound, to make flow all over
